title: Jastrow v2 entry
description: One entry of Jastrow's dictionary. Generated from admin/validation/schema.ts by bun schema:build; never edit this file by hand.

id.description: The rid, the id the entry is addressed by.

sefariaHeadword.description: Sefaria's headword for this rid, byte for byte.

headwords.description: Every form print sets on the headword line, in order. headwords[0] is the primary form.

display.description: How print lays out the headword line: a template whose {n} inserts headwords[n].text and whose every other character is literal notation, never Hebrew. Its only markup is <annotate id> around a {n} or a homograph numeral. Absent where the layout is not settled.

page.description: Where print sets this entry: page, and column a or b.

pos.description: Part of speech. No entry carries it.

stem.description: The stem label print gives (Pa., Hithpa., …).

forms.description: The headword forms this stem governs.

items.description: A binyan section of an entry, beside the entry's own senses.

annotations.description: The entry's annotations, which the text points to by id. Absent when there are none, never [].

id.description: Unique within the entry: a1, a2, … The text points to it with an <annotate id> tag in display, a gloss or a unit, or with a sense's annotation.

kind.description: print-error (a departure from print, corrected), kept (an oddity print sets, kept as printed) or illegible (print cannot be read; our best reading).

printed.description: Print's original value, shown to the reader; '' where print sets nothing. A homograph is written as print writes it (I), a label as its token without ) (5).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the print read or the ruling.

source.description: The id of the patch that wrote it. Absent on an annotation no patch wrote.

annotation.description: Where the entry departs from print, or keeps an oddity print sets, and why. The text points to it by id; every annotation is referenced exactly once.

text.description: The form as Hebrew text alone. The notation print sets around it is in the entry's display.

homograph.description: The Roman numeral beside this form, as a number. Shown in display when the entry has one.

reconstructed.description: Print stars this form as a reconstructed word. Only ever true.

gender.description: This form's gender label, as print sets it beside the form. An entry may have a gender on every headword or a grammar.gender, never both.

partial.description: This form is shown as printed and is never a lookup key: an ending after an ellipsis, or a phrase holding an abbreviated word. Only ever true.

formObject.description: One headword form. How print sets the forms around each other is the entry's display.

annotation.description: The id of the annotation this sense's label points to. Only on a sense with a label.

reconstructed.description: Print stars this sense's number (*2)). Only ever true, and only beside a label.

gloss.description: The sense's head text. On the entry's senses[0] it is the lead text, usually the whole definition.

units.description: The sense's numbered or lettered parts.
